commands.name: offline-controls

scope:
Inspect directory mode/ACL metadata on a fresh stopped paired DataRO clone.

No VM/network/SSH/account/private app/model execution, host sudo or ownership DB
changes. No access/permission repair, account content or stored guest UID/GID proof.

auxiliary-storage.bin.content_evidence: OS enforced copy-on-write clone; no whole-file SHA256 claim.

disk.img.content_evidence: OS enforced copy-on-write clone; no whole-file SHA256 claim.

hardware-model.bin.content_evidence: OS enforced copy-on-write clone; no whole-file SHA256 claim.

machine-id.bin.content_evidence: OS enforced copy-on-write clone; no whole-file SHA256 claim.

disk.img.content_evidence: OS clone followed by successful installer callback and observed stopped state; no whole-disk hash.

permissions_probe.error: ValueError('parent-relative users metadata not reached; retain earlier denial')
